caption:
When you have wronged yourself, say this

Adam and his wife did not make excuses. They admitted they had wronged themselves, then asked their Lord for forgiveness and mercy.

Surah Al-A'raaf 7:23

Say these words tonight, and mean every one of them

#tawbah #duaofadam #forgiveness #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: They said, “Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves; if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.” (Surah Al-A'raaf 7:23)
